title: Teko ya lenyora
intro: Morafe mongwe, o o neng o eletsa boeteledipele jo bo neng bo tla sireletsa kgang ya bone, o ne wa kopa gore go tlhomiwe molaodi gore o ba okamele. Fa kopo ya bone e arabiwa, yo o tlhophilweng o ne a amogelwa ka dipelaelo, ka gonne motho yono o ne a se na maemo a lefatshe a ba neng ba a lebeletse. Pele ga thulano ya bofelo, moeteledipele yono yo mosha o ne a tla leka go otlhaiwa ga masole ka teko e e motlhofo, mme e le e e tseneletseng, ya go ikgapa.
clues: Ke ne ka tlhomiwa go nna molaodi morago ga gore batho ba me ba batle moeteledipele yo o tla lwang mo ntlheng ya ga Allah.
Bontsi jwa batho ba gaetsho kwa tshimologong ba ne ba belaela go tlhomiwa ga me, ba umaka go tlhoka khumo ga me le losika lwa me lwa maemo a a kwa godimo.
Ke ne ka tlhophiwa ka gonne Allah o ne a nneile kitso e ntsi le mmele o o nonofileng.
Sesupo se se bonalang sentle sa go tlhomiwa ga me ka bomodimo e ne e le go boa ga Letlole la Kgolagano, le le neng le tshotswe ke baengele, le le neng la tlisa kagiso mo dipelong tsa badumedi.
Fa ke ntse ke gwanta le masole a me, ke ne ka itsise gore re tla lekwa ke noka.
Ke ne ka laela mophato wa me gore ope fela yo o neng a tla nwa thata mo nokeng e ne e se wa setlhopha sa me, fa ba ba neng ba tsaya sekopo se le sengwe fela mo seatleng sa bone ba ne ba tla sala.

options: Jalate (Goliathe)
Talute (Saulo)
Moporofeti Dawud
Dul-Qarnayn

trial.label: Teko ya me e Kgolo e ne e le efe?
options: Go aga sekgoreletsi kgatlhanong le Gogo le Magogo
Go lebana le seganka mo ntweng e le nngwe
Go leka kutlo ya mophato kwa nokeng
Go etelela pele mophato wa dijini le dinonyane
Go falola go latlhelwa mo molelong
trial.answer: Go leka kutlo ya mophato kwa nokeng

location.label: Sesupo sa Botlhokwa sa Taolo ya Me e ne e le eng?
options: Lore lo lo neng lwa fetoga noga
Kamela e e neng ya tswa mo lefikeng
Jase ya poso e e dirilweng ka tshipi e e nolofaditsweng
Letlole la Kgolagano (At-Tabut)
Tafole ya dijo tse di tswang kwa magodimong

outcome.label: Letsholo la me le Nne le Matswela Afe?
options: Go fenya mophato wa ga Jalut (Goliathe)
Go kgaoganya Lewatle le Lehibidu go tshaba mmusaesi
Go tlhoma losika lwa segosi lo lo tla nnelang ruri mo leineng la me
Go aga Kaaba e e boitshepo kwa Makkah
Go tlhatlosediwa kwa magodimong o sa swe
outcome.answer: Go fenya mophato wa ga Jalut (Goliathe)

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
